description: This file contains unit tests for the FrequentEdgeCounter class, used to track communication patterns in activation repartitioning within Orleans. It defines test classes, sets up test data, and verifies the behavior of adding and removing edges and managing capacity constraints.

classes.name: FrequentEdgeCounterTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for the FrequentEdgeCounter class behavior, including adding edges, updating counts, capacity management, and removal.

methods.name: Add_ShouldIncrementCounter_WhenEdgeIsAdded
methods.description: Tests that adding an edge increments its counter in the FrequentEdgeCounter.

methods.name: Add_ShouldUpdateExistingCounter_WhenSameEdgeIsAddedAgain
methods.description: Verifies that adding the same edge again updates its count.

methods.name: Add_ShouldRemoveMinCounter_WhenCapacityIsReached
methods.description: Ensures that when capacity is exceeded, the counter with the minimum count is removed.

methods.name: Remove_ShouldRemoveCounter_WhenEdgeIsRemoved
methods.description: Checks that removing an edge deletes its counter.
